Hardware probe: prove knobs 4..9 (pages 2/3, LineSel-cloned synthesized handlers) can be touched without freezing and that each writes its own params[] slot. Knobs 1..3 use the hardware-proven stock blobs (LineSel knob1/knob2 + AIR knob3); knobs 4..9 use linker synthesize_linesel_edit_handlers clones (knob_id 5..10, param_byte_off 32..52). The audio body maps each param to a distinct gain: odd knobs boost the L block, even knobs boost the R block, step (k+1)*0.04 per unit, so turning a knob is audibly identifiable and provably lands in params[5+k].

What to watch for after flashing:
  1. Load - does K9Probe appear in the Filter category browser?
  2. Page 1 (knobs 1-3): do all three knobs change gain without freezing?
  3. Navigate to page 2 (knobs 4-6) and page 3 (knobs 7-9): pedal stays alive when each knob is touched?
  4. Bypass toggle - does it stay alive?

Pass criterion: touch every knob on all three pages, the pedal never freezes, and each knob changes the output in its expected channel/amount.
